children: on Tuesday announced that the FDA has accepted its marketing application for its lead candidate, bezuclastinib, for a rare form of blood cancer, marking the third indication for which the tyrosine kinase inhibitor is currently under regulatory review in the U.S.
The FDA accepted the company’s new drug application for bezuclastini in advanced systemic mastocytosis, assigning June 29, 2027, as the target action date, Cogent
said, adding that the regulator has no plans to convene an advisory committee to discuss the NDA.
